subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “New systems may be efficient, but they must still leave room for people who are learning.”?
options: A good change should not make anyone feel locked outside.
It can also make the mind feel tired.
A familiar object can make a new place feel ready for work.
Not all good decisions feel good at the moment they are made.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「New systems may be efficient, but they must still leave room for people who are learning. A good change should not make…」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「It can also make the mind feel tired.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「A familiar object can make a new place feel ready for work.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Not all good decisions feel good at the moment they are made.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「New systems may be efficient, but they must still leave room for people who are learning. A good change should not make anyone feel…」，答案為「A good change should not make anyone feel locked outside.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「A good change should not make anyone feel locked outside.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
